description: The donut chart represents the distribution of task types, comparing the proportions of different categories. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, colored red, represents 'Article generation' and accounts for approximately 82.9% of the total. The second largest slice, colored blue, represents 'Article editing' and makes up around 14.6%. The smallest slice, colored yellow, represents 'Headline generation' and constitutes about 2.4%. The percentage labels are displayed outside the chart, adjacent to their corresponding slices. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with 'Article generation' being the largest, followed by 'Article editing', and then 'Headline generation'.
